plain_language_conclusion: Stop visual polish for this tranche and switch the engineer-day to payment validation; keep the page on a release-blocking-defect-only maintenance line.

allocation_frame.parent_objective: Launch a purchasable product page in the current release window.
allocation_frame.target_threshold: The page is usable and the payment path is validated for launch.
allocation_frame.risk_floor: Do not launch with an unvalidated payment path or a release-blocking page defect.
allocation_frame.evidence_ceiling: The page meets the current usability threshold; payment validation remains incomplete. This does not prove production revenue or long-term conversion impact.

candidate_horizon_probe.finding: Compared the active polish path with payment validation, defect-only maintenance, defer, and stop postures.
candidate_horizon_probe.failure_criteria_response: The active task did not own the candidate set merely because it was already in progress.
candidate_horizon_probe.evidence_surface: Release checklist and current page/payment status.

priority_order.finding: Payment validation is threshold-essential; animation polish is value-expanding after the page usability threshold has been reached.
priority_order.failure_criteria_response: Target feasibility and threshold necessity were considered before incremental polish value.
priority_order.evidence_surface: Launch threshold and unresolved payment acceptance item.

resource_contention.finding: Both actions require the same engineer-day in the same release window.
resource_contention.failure_criteria_response: The candidates genuinely contest one scarce resource rather than independent pools.
resource_contention.evidence_surface: Named engineer assignment and release schedule.

evidence_bounded_necessity.finding: Payment validation is necessary for the current launch threshold under the stated release contract.
evidence_bounded_necessity.failure_criteria_response: The necessity claim expires when payment validation passes or the launch threshold is explicitly changed by the release owner.
evidence_bounded_necessity.evidence_surface: Current acceptance criteria and payment validation status.

contraction.finding: The current page allocation contracts to release-blocking-defect-only maintenance while preserving the page usability threshold and risk floor.
contraction.failure_criteria_response: The first further reduction would leave a release-blocking page defect unresolved; animation polish is not part of the current floor.
contraction.evidence_surface: Current page acceptance status, defect list, and release threshold.

replenishment.finding: From the contracted page-maintenance floor, the next engineer-day goes to payment validation rather than renewed polish or idle reserve.
replenishment.failure_criteria_response: The next tranche is compared from the current floor and produces a decision-relevant validation result.
replenishment.evidence_surface: Payment acceptance gap, engineer availability, and expected validation artifact.

meaningful_tranche.finding: The next tranche is one bounded engineer-day ending in a reproducible payment validation result.
meaningful_tranche.failure_criteria_response: The comparison unit can produce an observable outcome rather than an arbitrary hour.
meaningful_tranche.evidence_surface: Validation task scope and expected test artifact.

switching_vs_sunk_cost.finding: Completed page work remains reusable; time already spent on polish is sunk, while context switching is limited to the current engineer handoff.
switching_vs_sunk_cost.failure_criteria_response: Past spend was not used as a reason to continue, and real switching cost was still represented.
switching_vs_sunk_cost.evidence_surface: Current branch state and remaining work estimate.

authorization_horizon.finding: Authorization ends after one engineer-day or the payment validation checkpoint, whichever comes first.
authorization_horizon.failure_criteria_response: Lite does not authorize open-ended continuation.

defer_stop_or_reserve.finding: Animation polish is explicitly deferred; page maintenance is limited to release-blocking defects.
defer_stop_or_reserve.failure_criteria_response: Displaced work is visible rather than silently remaining active.

rerank_trigger.finding: Rerank when payment validation passes, fails with a new blocker, or the page develops a release-blocking defect.
rerank_trigger.failure_criteria_response: The decision has observable conditions that reopen allocation.
rerank_trigger.evidence_surface: Payment test result and page defect status.

mode_boundary.finding: Lite is sufficient because the choice is bounded, reversible, and compares one current path with one strong alternative.
mode_boundary.failure_criteria_response: No multiple-bundle, irreversible, or multi-resource condition requires Full.

claim_ceiling.finding: The result supports this release-window allocation only.
claim_ceiling.failure_criteria_response: The output does not claim universal priority accuracy, optimal ROI, or future revenue improvement.
claim_ceiling.evidence_surface: Current acceptance criteria and explicit uncertainty statement.

considered_candidates: Maintain the page for release-blocking defects only.
lite_decision.current_floor: Keep the product page at release-blocking-defect-only maintenance; animation polish is outside the current target floor.
lite_decision.next_tranche: Allocate one engineer-day to payment validation and produce a reproducible result.
displaced_work: Maintain the page only for release-blocking defects.
lite_decision.rerank_trigger: Payment validation passes or fails with a new blocker, or a release-blocking page defect appears.
